For Developers — GitHub Repositories Related to ResStock

These repositories are publicly available to use, but we are not able to provide technical support or documentation for running ResStock at this time. We strongly suggest and support using the public datasets. The data outputs from the initial ResStock release can be found by visiting the [Data](docs/data.md) page.

For Developers — GitHub Repositories Related to ResStock > ResStock Repository

The [ResStock repository](https://github.com/NatLabRockies/resstock) contains the source code for building and executing ResStock models, including upgrade scenarios. It also links to a [Technical Development Guide](https://resstock.readthedocs.io/en/latest/index.html) which has basic and advanced tutorials.

metadata.section: GitHub Repositories Related to ResStock > ResStock Repository

text:
For Developers — GitHub Repositories Related to ResStock > OpenStudio-HPXML Repository

ResStock relies heavily on [OpenStudio-HPXML](https://github.com/NatLabRockies/OpenStudio-HPXML), which provides a method for simulating residential buildings with OpenStudio and EnergyPlus. OpenStudio-HPXML uses a series of OpenStudio measures to generate an EnergyPlus model for each sample based on the building and occupant characteristics defined by ResStock. In many cases, ResStock relies upon the OpenStudio-HPXML default arguments and calculations.

metadata.section: GitHub Repositories Related to ResStock > OpenStudio-HPXML Repository

text:
For Developers — GitHub Repositories Related to ResStock > Buildstock Batch Repository

Execution of the ResStock workflow is managed through the [buildstockbatch repository](https://github.com/NatLabRockies/buildstockbatch), a shared asset of ResStock and ComStock. It is specifically developed to scale to execution of tens of millions of simulations through multiple infrastructure providers.

metadata.section: GitHub Repositories Related to ResStock > Buildstock Batch Repository

For Developers — GitHub Repositories Related to ResStock > BuildStock Query Repository

[buildstock-query](https://github.com/NatLabRockies/buildstock-query) is a Python library for querying datasets generated by ResStock and ComStock. Introductory tutorial videos can be found on the [NLR Learning BuildStock Analysis YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jmmAHsOZAp8&list=PLmIn8Hncs7bEYCZiHaoPSovoBrRGR-tRS&index=6).
